title: Film credits: Five Pennies, American in Paris, Panic in the Streets and others
summary: Carter lists his arranging and playing roles on several films.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Let's touch on a number of things that you did for films. I won't worry about the dates or the order because these can be checked in various directories, you know, of film music, and by the way, let's talk about on TV, too. But I would like to mention some of these films, and get clear what your role was in one way or another. As examples of your work during the fifties, sixties, and down to the present.
Maybe perhaps, dealing a little bit with the earlier ones. Let's again, in no particular chronological order ... Pennies "The Five Pennies" -- you did something on that film.
I did some arranging, and it seems there was a sequence in there where there was ... someone portrayed Jimmy Dorsey.
And I played, you know, on the soundtrack on the background what Jimmy Dorsey was supposed to be playing in the picture.
"American in Paris" I did some arrangements on the film, and I had I think it was a sextette, on screen -- I suppose it was in a nightclub scene.
And that, I think, has been
repeated recently, or shown again in this ...
"That's Entertainment" number one, or part one, that is.
That was the same. Where I did some arranging on the picture, and I also had a small group, probably a sextet in a scene at a house party, I believe it was.

"Panic in the Streets" I did well, quite a lot of writing on that, arranging, and there was an interesting thing about "Panic in the Streets". That was the first picture ... no, oh no ... am I thinking about "Panic in the Streets?" No, I was thinking about "No Way Out". But "Panic in the Streets", yes, I also wrote a little blues song for that picture. A thing called "No Good Man" that was sung in there by Helen Humes. Yes, that was Jack Palance.
"The Sun Also Rises" ... what did I do? I did some writing on that, and playing.
Navarone I did some arranging with Dimitri Tiomkin.
